label: Carried Zhuangzian spontaneity and naturalness into Wei-Jin Xuanxue philosophical conversation
description: A celebrated practitioner of Xuanxue ("Dark Learning") and pure conversation (qingtan), Xie Daoyun embodied Zhuangzi’s aesthetic spontaneity in philosophical debate.
dialecticalTension: Translates classical Daoist spontaneity into elite Wei-Jin dialectical wit.

citations.author: Liu Yiqing
citations.work: Shishuo Xinyu (A New Account of the Tales of the World)

label: Expanded Ban Zhao’s precedent of female scholarly authority into autonomous philosophical debate
description: While Ban Zhao worked within Han Confucian court historiography, Xie Daoyun publicly bested male literati in Xuanxue metaphysical debate.
dialecticalTension: Shifts female intellectual voice from Confucian domestic instruction to dialectical qingtan.
historicalContext: Han to Eastern Jin women’s intellectual lineage.

citations.author: Xie Daoyun
citations.work: Recorded Debates in Jinshu & Shishuo Xinyu

label: Established the canonical Chinese archetype of women’s philosophical and poetic genius
description: Song literati—and Li Qingzhao herself—invoked Xie Daoyun’s "talent for chanting about snow" as the benchmark of women’s autonomous literary-philosophical intellect.
dialecticalTension: Sustains an enduring Chinese counter-canon of female scholarly brilliance.
